name: Semicircle Fence Flag
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from 100% polyester fabric, offering a lightweight, durable, and weather-friendly display option.
    - Features a unique semicircle shape that creates a stylish and eye-catching decorative look for fences, railings, and outdoor spaces.
    - Finished with a reinforced stitched hem for improved durability and a cleaner appearance.
    - Includes three metal grommets for secure hanging and easy installation.
    - Soft yet sturdy fabric allows the flag to hang beautifully while maintaining a neat display.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes:
              +) 36 x 18 in  ~ 91.44 x 45.72 cm
              +) 48 x 24 in ~ 121.92 x 60.96 cm
              +) 72 x 36 in ~ 182.88 x 91.44 cm
    📌 Note: Due to manual measurement, there may be an error of 1–3 cm.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Vibrant all-over sublimation print for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a decorative outdoor flag and a personalized display piece.
    - Designed to hang easily on fences, railings, porches, balconies, and outdoor walls.
    - The semicircle shape adds a unique and elegant decorative touch to outdoor spaces.
    - Suitable for holidays, seasonal decorating, parties, patriotic displays, and everyday outdoor décor.
    - Lightweight and easy to install using the included grommet structure.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful decorative gift for family members, friends, neighbors, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for holidays, housewarmings, birthdays, patriotic celebrations, and seasonal events.
    - Ideal for anyone who enjoys outdoor decorating and personalized home accents.
    - A thoughtful gift for garden lovers, porch decorators, and festive home stylists.
    - Great for fence décor, yard displays, porch decoration, and celebration backdrops.
    - Adds a bright, festive, and personal touch to any outdoor space🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Semicircle Fence Flag

 

PRODUCTION

NOTE

  • Please allow 1-3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
